tool_calls.name: draft_sample_rationale
tool_calls.arguments: {"rationale":"A targeted records review is useful for the unresolved questions: whether Riverside's 2025 DRG 871 cases met the clinical sepsis criteria used by the plan, and whether the higher DRG 871 share reflects documentation practices after the January 2024 CDI program or true clinical differences not visible in claims. The review should also check whether transferred-in cases were coded consistently and whether the higher DRG 871 share is concentrated in specific documentation patterns or patient presentations. A sample review can answer these record-level questions, but the sampled charts cannot be extrapolated to Riverside's other stays or used to generalize beyond the reviewed cases."}
